info.description: Directory Connector sample: synchronise users, authenticate and manage passwords. Run in order against a freshly started sample; password operations change the in-memory demo users. Restart before running again. Set claimsFormat to ClaimsList or Properties to match AppSettings:ClaimsFormat on the running sample.

exec: if (!['ClaimsList', 'Properties'].includes(format)) throw new Error('Set claimsFormat to ClaimsList or Properties.');

const claims = format === 'Properties' ? { name: 'New User', role: ['read_access', 'write_access'] } : [{ type: 'name', value: 'New User' }, { type: 'role', value: 'read_access' }, { type: 'role', value: 'write_access' }];
pm.test('Configured claims format', () => properties ? pm.expect(claims).to.be.an('object') : pm.expect(claims).to.be.an('array'));
const roles = properties ? claims.role : claims.filter(c => c.type === 'role').map(c => c.value);
